    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        A = input[index]
        index += 1
        B = input[index]
        index += 1
        if A == B:
            results.append(0)
            continue
        if set(A) & set(B) == set():
            results.append(-1)
            continue
        count_A = [0] * 20
        count_B = [0] * 20
        for i in range(n):
            count_A[ord(A[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
            count_B[ord(B[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
        moves = 0
        for i in range(20):
            if count_A[i] > count_B[i]:
                moves += count_A[i] - count_B[i]
        results.append(moves)
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))
